card.name: Capsules after drug names
card.fires_on: The word "capsules" or its first piece "Caps" right after a drug name, often after "extended-release" or a salt name such as hydrochloride or phosphate.

modes.label: Caps- start of the word
modes.description: The first piece "Caps" of "capsules" after a drug name, before "ules".

modes.label: Whole word capsules
modes.description: The full word "capsules" naming the dosage form after the drug name or "extended-release".
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Esomeprazole magnesium is supplied as delayed-release<< capsules>> for oral administration.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug name is followed by the word capsules.
